title: Bone Marrow-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells Modified with Akt1 Ameliorates Acute Liver GVHD
author: Zhou, Liu, et al.
materials: At the time of sacrifice, liver tissue samples were collected, fixed in 4% formaldehyde for 24h and embedded in paraffin. Then 3-μm liver sections were deparaffinized and fixed. Section samples were stained with hematoxylin solution (Sigma-Aldrich, Germany) for 5 min followed by eosin for 5 min. TNF-α and IFN-γ in liver sections were detected by immunohistochemistry (BOSTER.Bio, China) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. For serum transaminase assay, serum ALT and AST levels were measured with an automated biochemical analyzer (Roche Integra 800, USA).

steps.title: Extract RNA from cells
steps.instruction: Lyse cells and isolate total RNA using TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen, USA) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA from RNA
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe the purified RNA into complementary DNA using M‑MLV Reverse Transcriptase (Life Technologies, USA) following the enzyme’s instructions.

steps.title: Perform qRT‑PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Set up quantitative real‑time PCR reactions with the SYBR Green PCR kit (Takara, Japan) on an Applied Biosystems 7500 Real‑Time PCR system (USA) using the following primer pairs: AKT1 (5'-AACGGACTTCGGGCTGTG-3' / 5'-TTGTCCTCCAGCACCTCAGG-3'), HGF (5'-ATCCACGATGTTCATGAGAG-3' / 5'-GCTGACTGCATTTCTCATTC-3'), VEGF (5'-GCGGGCTGCCTCGCAGTC-3' / 5'-TCACCGCCTTGGCTTGTCAC-3'), IL‑4 (5'-AGAGATCATCGGCATTTTGAACGA-3' / 5'-CGAGCTCACTCTCTGTGGTGT TCT-3'), IL‑10 (5'-CTTGCACTACCAAAGCCACA-3' / 5'-GTTATTGTCTTCCCGGC TGT-3'), PTGES2 (5'-ACTTCCACTCCCTGCCCT-3' / 5'-CAGGTACCAAGGCTGGAT GT-3'). Follow the kit’s cycling conditions.

steps.title: Collect and fix liver tissue
steps.instruction: At sacrifice, excise liver samples, fix them in 4 % formaldehyde for 24 h, then embed the tissue in paraffin.

steps.title: Section and deparaffinize samples
steps.instruction: Cut 3‑μm thick sections from the paraffin‑embedded liver blocks, deparaffinize the sections and re‑fix them as required.

steps.title: Hematoxylin‑eosin stain sections
steps.instruction: Stain the deparaffinized sections with hematoxylin solution (Sigma‑Aldrich, Germany) for 5 min, then counter‑stain with eosin for 5 min.

steps.title: Immunostain for TNF‑α and IFN‑γ
steps.instruction: Detect TNF‑α and IFN‑γ in the liver sections by immunohistochemistry using the BOSTER.Bio (China) kit, following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Measure serum ALT and AST
steps.instruction: Analyze serum samples for alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) levels using an automated biochemical analyzer (Roche Integra 800, USA).

steps.title: Analyze data statistically
steps.instruction: Calculate results as mean ± SD, compare groups with an unpaired Student’s t‑test, and consider P < 0.05 as statistically significant.
